identity.title: Mango and Bamboo Capital
identity.description: San Carlos City is the provincial and national reference point for carabao mango and bamboo products - the "Mango and Bamboo Capital of the Philippines" / "Mango-Bamboo Capital of the North" - a major trading center for bamboo-based products and furniture and a top producer of carabao mangoes.

mango.trees_stat_note: Over 127,000 fruit-bearing mango trees per the LGU tourism page (2008 report)
products: Mango pie (city set the world's-largest record in 2011)

bamboo.note: The Mango-Bamboo Festival doubles as a trade hub for producers and traders of bamboo and mango products.
